content:
mina: Quickstart fail for a new SSO-created workspace. First call -> 402 Payment Required, then the sample app attempted to auto-create a trial and got 409 conflict, user saw generic timeout.

jon_devx: Which quickstart and SDK?

mina: python sample-app (repo starter), SDK py 0.9.4. Minimal curl: 
```
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -d '{"input":"hi"}'
HTTP/1.1 402 Payment Required
x-workspace-status: billing_required
{"error":"payment_required"}
```

mina: The app includes a helper to auto-provision trials if billing missing; that helper retried and hit a 409 from billing service which the UI surfaced as a 504. Confusing UX.

infra-bot: quick-audit: initial 402 from control-plane; helper flow called billing-provision endpoint and got 409 conflict (trial already queued) -> helper retried 3x -> edge rate-limited subsequent calls -> client saw timeout. Trace tr_2120003333-aa.

samir: Two actions: (1) disable auto-provision helper in sample-app (quick PR) so first-time users see the billing console prompt instead of hidden retries, (2) SDK should not retry on 4xx.

jon_devx: Agreed. Mina, can you open PR to remove auto-provision or make it opt-in? Also file SDK issue to treat 4xx as terminal.

mina: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/samples/pull/401 (make trial opt-in). Filed SDK bug #421. Will update onboarding docs to clarify SSO-created orgs need explicit billing enable.

samir: I'll add a note to the billing team about returning clearer error codes (409 vs 422) when a trial is already in flight.

jon_devx: Thanks. Keeping thread open until sample PR merged and SDK issue triaged. If anyone repros, drop trace id above.
